{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data to verify the premises
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nUnique arms:", df['arm'].unique())
print("\nUnique severities:", df['severity'].unique())
print("\nUnique assay_batch:", df['assay_batch'].unique())
print("\nSample_seq max:", df['sample_seq'].max())
print("\nDuplicate patient_id count:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check response distribution
print("\nResponded distribution:", df['responded'].value_counts(dropna=False))"}
